purpose: P3-T1 art direction and offline owner review
settingsNotes: Each job used generate create cinematic_studio_2_5, --aspect-ratio 3:2 --resolution 2k --batch-size 1. The service chose its default auto mode and assigned a seed. Sheets received one --image pointing to the selected completed board job. Every reference ID was matched against returned params.medias. No separate negative-prompt or upscaling pass.

billing.evidence: Per-job generate cost quotation and account transactions. The transaction feed omits job IDs. The spend events were matched one-to-one in creation order by model, amount and timestamp within one second of each job. Provider timestamps are UTC.

sourceHistory: Unmodified provider PNGs, downloaded directly from completed result URLs. The JPEG contact sheets in previews are review derivatives, assembled from their named source PNGs; no assets in this set are runtime files.
rights: The six boards use project-written text only. All eleven sheets use one project-generated board. No third-party image inputs. Higgsfield Terms of Use §4.4 allows commercial use of outputs. Its creator help center states attribution is optional and exclusive outputs are not guaranteed.

outputs.prompt: A wide original material and shape study for Rift Bastion, a tabletop-scale mixed reality science fiction defense game. Build one curated industrial design presentation on a neutral studio cyclorama. Dominant hero: squat faceted octagonal Core Bastion with floating violet-cyan crystal and encircling emitter. Adjacent small fictional turret, wall-flush tall oval violet/teal portal, and one contrasting insectoid alien with obsidian chitin. Show material samples: bead-blasted brushed titanium, broad matte slate ceramic shells, inset carbon structure, light localized to recesses. Amber kinetic, orange plasma, cyan cryo, cobalt-white rail each read as discrete energy accents. Crisp inspectable surfaces, no people, no text, no labels, no logo, no existing franchise designs. All objects wholly in frame. Folded shield plates: three massive ceramic facets separated by deep dark seams, near-black undershell, brushed silver bevels. Neutral grey field. Hero at left; quiet hard studio light, spare, sober aerospace industrial catalog.
